variants.hypothesis: explicit lexical senses without sentence-specific examples
variants.prompt: Translate the supplied message faithfully between Korean and Lao. Keep people, actions, objects, negation, time, quantities, symptoms, emotion and speech act unchanged. Do not add gender, ownership, names or facts that are absent. Preserve ambiguity rather than guessing. Return only the requested translation.
variants.notes: Disambiguate common Lao senses: ລາວ used as a pronoun refers to a third person, not a personal name. ຮາກ/ອ້ວກ are vomiting; ປວດຮາກ/ຢາກຮາກ express nausea/urge to vomit; ແພ້ທ້ອງ is pregnancy morning sickness. Preserve these senses when present, with negation and event-vs-feeling distinction. Unspecified 동생 has no licensed gender or owner.
